title: The Computational Anatomy of a National Competency Standard: code, results, and manuscripts
description:
Code, aggregate results, and manuscripts for The Computational Anatomy of a National Competency Standard: Regularity, Redundancy, and Terminological Fragmentation in Korea's NCS (Chung & Ryu, Sahmyook University). Pre-registered complete-census analysis of Korea's National Competency Standards (1,109 occupations; 196,658 performance criteria; 2.46 million KSA items), replicated on ESCO v1.2.1 and validated by fourteen external raters (960 judgments). Row-level NCS derivatives (per-occupation metrics, alias dictionary, candidate-merge file) are deposited as a separate dataset record.

This publication uses the ESCO classification of the European Commission. NCS-derived tables are subject to the Korea Open Government License Type 1 (attribution; source: Human Resources Development Service of Korea).
